messages:
Maeve L.: Quick sync — following up on INC-2026 postmortem actions. Need confirmations on owners, blockers, and any dependency work before the planned cutover on Monday 06:00 UTC. Please reply with owner + status + ETA.

Ravi P.: I'm on the schema migration action (db-migrate). Targeting Thu EOD. Blocker: confirm read replica snapshot window (pinging infra). Will update here once snapshot is reserved. @OpsBot can you confirm snapshot window availability?

OpsBot: infra-scheduler reports: next full snapshot window available Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC. Reservation required 24h in advance.

Katherine S.: I own the canary routing change and rollback playbook. ETA Friday 14:00 UTC for tests. Need Jin to finish the client lib patch for 1.3.2 compatibility (dependency).

Jin H.: Client lib patch submitted, awaiting review @Noah B. If merged today I can cut a release and push canary artifacts by Thu evening. Otherwise Friday morning.

Noah B.: Reviewing PR now. Small lint fix, then I can approve. No other blockers from SDK team.

Maeve L.: Summarizing current owners/ETAs:
- db-migrate: Ravi P. — Thu EOD (waiting infra snapshot)
- canary routing + rollback: Katherine S. — Fri 14:00 UTC (depends on client patch)
- client lib release: Jin H./Noah B. — Thu EOD or Fri AM
- postmortem doc finalization: Maeve L. — Fri 18:00 UTC

Maeve L.: Action items that could delay cutover:
1) Snapshot not reserved by Fri 02:00 — impact: migration delayed >24h (owner: Ravi)
2) Client patch not released — impact: routing tests fail (owners: Jin/Noah)
3) Canary rollback steps not validated — impact: manual rollback required (owner: Katherine)

Katherine S.: I'll schedule a dry-run of the rollback procedure for Fri 16:00 UTC and invite Ops + Infra. If anyone can't make it, drop a note here and I'll record the session.

Ravi P.: Reserved snapshot for Fri 02:00 UTC. OpsBot confirmed reservation (ref: SNAP-2026-42). Updating status to green.

OpsBot: Reservation confirmed: SNAP-2026-42 — Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC. Reminder will fire 24h prior.

Jin H.: PR merged. Pushed client lib 1.3.2-rc1. Artifact URL: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/client/1.3.2-rc1.tar.gz

Noah B.: Verified smoke tests against 1.3.2-rc1. LGTM, tagging release. I'll promote to stable and notify CI to rebuild canary images.

Noah B.: Promotion done. Canary image builds queued.

Maeve L.: Great — with snapshot reserved and client release promoted, we look set for the planned Monday cutover. Please update your P0/P1 task status in the incident tracker. If anything changes, call it out here ASAP. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
